title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Tenure Uplift on Registry Price Protection (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
1. On registry price protection for a Merchandise Purchases unit, a registrant whose active Finch Circle membership was enrolled at least the long-tenure months of 120 months before the request date (whole months) receives the long protection tenure uplift of 1.10.
2. A registrant enrolled at least the middle-tenure months of 60 months but fewer than 120 months before it receives the middle protection tenure uplift of 1.05.
3. A registrant enrolled fewer than 60 whole months before the request date, or with no active membership, is outside these terms.
4. Tenure is counted in whole months from the enrollment date on the active membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program records to the request date.

*Hypothetical illustrations.* Enrolled 120 whole months before the request date: 1.10. Enrolled 119 whole months before: 1.05. Enrolled 60 whole months before: 1.05. Enrolled 59: outside these terms. A paid-share difference of $30.00 multiplied by 1.10 is $33.00, and by 1.05 is $31.50.
